paper_title: 1.4 Million Open-Source Distilled Reasoning Dataset to Empower Large   Language Model Training
caption: Distribution of data entries across different task categories. The dataset primarily consists of Math (29.3%), Coding (24.3%), and Information Seeking (22.2%) tasks, followed by Reasoning (10.4%), Planning (2.3%), Creative Writing (2.2%), and other combined categories (9.3%).
model_annotation: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of data entries across different task categories within a dataset. The chart contains seven slices, representing Math, Coding, Information Seeking, Reasoning, Planning, Creative Writing, and a combined “Others” category. The slices are colored yellow, blue, green, orange, pink, purple, and light green respectively. Math accounts for approximately 29.3% of the data, Coding for 24.3%, and Information Seeking for 22.2%. Reasoning comprises 10.4%, while Planning is 2.3% and Creative Writing is 2.2%. The remaining “Others” category represents 9.3% of the data. Percentage labels are displayed inside each slice, and a legend is provided listing each category with its corresponding color. The slices appear to be visually ordered in a descending fashion based on their proportional size.
